# W104: an element takes part in no relation, data placement, or scenario

**Severity:** warning · **Stage:** validator

An element that nothing refers to is usually left over from an earlier design.

## Failing example

```saxl
system Shop
actor Buyer
service Web
service Legacy
Buyer -> Web
```

## Fixed example

```saxl
system Shop
actor Buyer
service Web
Buyer -> Web
```
